history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). She is looking directly at the camera with a mischievous expression, her mouth open to reveal braces on her teeth and her tongue sticking out slightly. The brim of the black cap is pulled down low, covering the top half of her face. The background is dark and out of focus, creating a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the woman and her cap. The overall mood is playful, rebellious, and a little bit edgy.
